controls.label: Color
controls.qualification: Colour from Gaia's spectrum of the star; darkening toward the edge fitted here to TESS transits of HD 189733b. The disc itself is unresolved.
controls.notes: The colour of Gaia DR3's measured spectrum. The edge darkening is fitted to 30 TESS transits (600–1000 nm): the edge is about a third as bright as the centre. The axis is tilted about 14° from the planet's orbit, as measured; the star is spotted; one transit-chord reconstruction is available in the 2021 spot lens, but no global map exists.

controls.label: 2021 spot
controls.qualification: Static reconstruction of one TESS spot-crossing candidate in HD 189733b transit 2165. The paper gives a minimum 5° angular radius and 7.6% TESS-band contrast; position along the transit chord comes from its timing and the hosted orbit. Shape, sky orientation and Gaia-colour application are display assumptions.
controls.notes: Haris et al. (2025), Table 3, transit 2165 at BJD-2450000 9435.46: event midpoint +1890 s, minimum angular radius 5.0°, contrast 0.076. This is a single candidate dark region along the planet’s path, shown on a fixed camera-facing limb plate. It is not a resolved surface image, global map or time-varying rotation. TESS-band darkness is displayed achromatically over the Gaia-colour photosphere.
